name: Berg CRM API
description:
# Knowledge base Detailed information about the API can be found in [knowledge base](https://help.bergsystem.pl/pl/) # About this document The following specification describes REST API for Berg CRM. # Versioning Specification versioning follows [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/) # Cloud version vs server version There's one specification for both versions as cloud version difference is only additional field for tenant identification (X-Tenant). # Authorization API uses oAuth 2.0 protocol for authorization. To receive an access token, use the `/token` endpoint.
The `/token` endpoint is the only endpoint with `content-type application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, all others use `application/vnd.api+json`.
If you use default `machine_to_machine` authorization, you should use the following keys in the POST request to the token endpoint: `client_id`, `client_secret`, `scope`, `grant_type`. All values can be found on the API configuration page.
If you use `api_all` authorization, you should also send `username` and `password` (without the `x-tenant` header). Details can be found in the Knowledge Base.
For the Cloud version API, the `X-Tenant` header is required for every request (even for the `/token` endpoint). To obtain it, you should use the `api_all` scope and log in via username and password, or check it on the API configuration page.
# Prevents duplication Our API includes built-in duplicate protection mechanisms for Customers, Companies, and Employees endpoints to ensure data integrity. This prevents the creation of identical records and helps maintain a clean database.
However, we understand there may be situations where you need to bypass this protection and force the addition of records, even if they appear to be duplicates.
To disable the duplicate protection and force the addition of a record, you should use the option `forceAdd = true` within your request. This option is applicable to the Customers, Companies, and Employees endpoints.
By setting `forceAdd` to `true`, you will instruct the API to ignore the duplicate check and proceed with adding the provided data as a new record. Please use this option judiciously and only when you have a legitimate need to create potentially duplicate entries.
# Language support API supports polish and english language, independently from profile settings. For english results, include `lang = en` in your requests, for example `/person/1/fields?lang=en`.
